as_of.initialization_note: Arlequino and Rena reached a caravan/merchant information counter in Dwargon. Rena's Eurazania inquiry produced its first major causal result: both now know the Eurazania capital was destroyed on T+161 after Milim's attack. Exact evacuee destinations remain unresolved. Organizer and home-search tasks are still active but not yet resolved. Students and Bren continue independent Gvazimodo preparation.

processes.objective: Find an organizer/coordinator for concerts and broader creative/operational work.
processes.current_state: Rena and Arlequino have reached a plausible caravan/merchant information counter. The contact has so far been used for Eurazania information; no organizer candidate has yet been identified or contacted.
constraints: Scope is broader than one concert.
Rena chooses her own method consistent with character and knowledge.
No organizer acceptance may be fabricated before contacts and time exist.
advance_when: Rena turns the current or next contact toward organizer referrals.
A named or role-based intermediary is causally encountered.
A real organizer candidate is identified or contacted.

processes.objective: Determine through causal in-world channels where Eurazania evacuees were sent and where they can currently be found.
processes.current_state: A caravan/merchant information clerk in Dwargon has provided the first major causal report: the Eurazania capital was destroyed on T+161 after Milim's attack. This confirms catastrophic context to Rena and Arlequino but does not resolve exact evacuee destinations. The clerk does not know the exact current distribution or the condition of 18 Old Garden Street.
processes.location_context: Dwargon with inquiry targets potentially outside Dwargon
constraints: No omniscient access to evacuation records.
Results require plausible sources and delays.
Exact evacuee distribution remains unresolved until causally learned.
Capital destruction alone does not establish the condition of the couple's old home.
dependencies: Further caravan, guild, refugee, official or messenger sources.
Travel or message delay where sources are not local.
advance_when: Rena asks the current clerk for routing leads or records.
Another causal source provides partial destination information.
A refugee, official, caravan master or guild contact is reached.

processes.objective: Begin gathering realistic new-home options for Rena and Arlequino.
processes.current_state: No property contact or option is established. The newly learned destruction of the Eurazania capital may affect urgency, but no automatic conclusion about the old home's condition or new-home city is permitted.
constraints: Exact city is unresolved.
Exact budget is unresolved; family funds are approximately ~358g.
Final purchase decision is not delegated.
Property availability, price, ownership, access and transaction time must be respected.
Do not assume 18 Old Garden Street was destroyed without a specific source.
advance_when: Rena finishes or pauses the first inquiry route.
She encounters a plausible property-information channel.

processes.objective: Develop and stage «Гвазимодо» with the Dwargon students.
processes.current_state: Casting is complete. Students continue self-organized rehearsal and production work. Bren continues refining a first-pass availability picture and grouping plausible rehearsal blocks, but no final schedule is fixed because the concert date remains unknown and some individual confirmations may still be outstanding.
constraints: Do not replay casting.
Use finalized cast authority.
Dain remains the tree as punishment unless changed.
Jobs, fatigue, venue access, meals, travel and other obligations limit rehearsal time.
Concert date is not yet fixed.
dependencies: Concert date clarification by Arlequino today or tomorrow.
advance_when: Bren materially advances or completes scheduling.

processes.objective: Simulate continuing consequences of the capital's destruction.
processes.current_state: The T+161 destruction anchor remains in aftermath. By T+162 ~13:18 the core destruction news has causally reached Arlequino and Rena in Dwargon through a caravan/merchant network contact. Exact refugee distribution, exact home-level damage and Carrion's true fate remain unresolved/restricted.
constraints: Do not invent exact casualty numbers or refugee destinations.
Do not infer the condition of 18 Old Garden Street from city-wide destruction alone.
Carrion's true survival remains restricted until canonically revealed.
advance_when: Refugees, officials, traders, guilds and messengers move.
Arlequino or Rena interacts with affected networks.

maintenance.on_substantial_time_advance: Review every relevant active process and persist justified partial progress, blocking reason, completion or failure.
